non_invalidators: PR body, title, comment, review, Draft, or Ready metadata change
failed pre-I/O placeholder, stdin, history, or empty-environment path lookup
creation of a descendant private-path rebind branch containing the PR #231 merge SHA
invalidators: change to the accepted PR #230 operator implementation or PR #231 isolated operator pin
change beyond the explicitly reviewed private-path digest and its derived writer/window/operator authorization digests
change to storage limits, event count, transition count, runtime authority flags, or validation workflow
artifact loss, corruption, or SHA-256 mismatch

next_chat_rule: Read this pin and PR #231's durable post-merge record before any validation or operator action. A chat or shell change never authorizes duplicate CI, witness, retained-sequence, or private-device execution.
